text: Went for brunch and it did not disappoint! Their bloody Mary's are fantastic and the food was delightful. I was told their menu changes seasonally so I can't wait to try more.
Great spot! Lasagna was to die for, service was spectacular and atmosphere was perfect!
My go-to spot for NY style pizza in Clearwater. Nice crispy outer crust. A little pricey but it's worth it in my opinion.

Subito is an absolute dream and the perfect lunch for a chilly day. It took a while for me to give it a go since I tend to bring lunch when the weather cools down, but I'm so glad I finally did!

BF and I did curbside pick up on a Friday around noon. It only took 10 minutes for our order to be ready! So quick. We split a TBOB and a Super sandwich. Both were insanely delicious and I can't decide which one I liked more. We also each got a small side soup of their daily special. It happened to be Chicken Tortilla and Korean Brisket Stew that day. We went with the Stew because it sounded so unique and it more than delivered - hearty and savory without feeling heavy. 

We felt so satisfied and happy for under $12 a person. Not bad for a big lunch that tasted homemade! Look forward to ordering again soon.

This past Sunday was my first time going to ShopRite and I absolutely fell in love with the store.  I usually shop at Giant in Willow Grove but lately they have hardly anything, no matter what time of day or night I go.  I was really skeptical going to ShopRite due to a lot of negative reviews on here.  But, the store was clean, fully stocked and the employees were all courteous and couldn't be anymore helpful and pleasant. This will be my new place to shop.
Horrible customer service I called in my food I still had to wait 45 minutes this is the second time
I've been eating here for almost 7 years, and it's my preferred Chinese takeout. Everything tastes fresh and it's always a short wait

I've been craving good sushi and my husband found this restaurant on yelp. We looked at the menu and were impressed by the selections available. We ordered the Vegas Roll (AMAZING), the volcano roll (good) and rainbow roll (AMAZING). My husband and son got the P5 (beef, meatballs) and I got the P9 (seafood) and we were ALL very please with our food. We will definitely return and are all full!! 
Filling and worth the money. We highly recommend this restaurant.

All I can say is WOW. This place was amazing! You can't even tell the food is vegan by taste! Cuban tacos were our favorite. Tamales were excellent too. The staff was friendly - we were greeted as we walked in a walked through the menu by a staff member since we'd never been here. All around great experience and we will definitely be back.

Hot pot is HOT! We walked in on a busy Saturday night and we were seated quickly. 

This was my first adventure into the world of hot pot. I was not feeling adventurous and the foods all looked quite strange. There is a wide variety and selection of stuff I have no clue what it was. 

I tried a few items and felt lackluster. Then our server made me a sauce and it changed everything. The short ribs were my favorite. I did wish there had been more traditional American veggies. But then it wouldn't be a Korean hot pot. 

All in all, I have the place 4 stars. The funniest part is they served Tiramisu for dessert. Hmmmm

We went for our 37th wedding an anniversary, just the hibs and I. The service and food were great. We got the daily special of the fritters. They were crab n chorizo. They were very good but honestly I did not taste much chorizo. I also got the baked oysters......they were outstanding although I added a little salt 
For dinner hubs got the grouper sandwich with the yuca fries. He got the grouper grilled both were excellent. Probably the best yuca fries I've ever had. Their starter sauce was excellant, most restaurants I always doctor it up for my taste. This one was perfect. 
I got the fish tacos, which we boxed up to take home. They will be lunch tomorrow. With the Caribbean slaw......it was so good!!!!. 
We split a key line pie for desser, it was excellent. Made with condensed milk (I am not usually a fan of) but this one is excellent.  It had a meringue topping which was good but we prefer a fresh whip cream. Which they had on there to cover up gaps in the meringue.  The fresh whip cream topping would have been preferred. 
We will definitely go back!!!! I wish they were open for lunch!!! The prices we on par for the food and restaurant!!.

This is one sweet hotspot for sushi!. Typically with all you can eat sushi the preparation can feel rushed and the focus is on quantity over quality.

That is not the case and gnocchi. This felt like a maid to order pay as you go sushi restaurant with the convenience of all you can eat sushi. I especially loved the salmon which was outstandingly fresh. The consistency of the cuts were excellent and these tasted mostly like the belly cuts with minimal connective tissue.

Th unagi was perfectly cooked and the eel sauce was not too sweet. 

I also enjoyed the And rolls which were loaded with good quality fish. Overall there was an excellent fish to rice ratio which is something I look for an an all you can eat sushi restaurant.

I will definitely be back to get you in the future

I tried Chef Tia's for the first time this weekend and Y'ALLLLLLL... when I tell you the chef put her FOOT in this, I mean HER WHOLE FOOT. Both feet. All 10 toes. We ordered the shrimp and grits and crawfish étouffée to go, and I was already ready to go back and try more dishes after finishing my meal. So savory, perfectly seasoned, and just the right portions to get you right. We're already looking forward to our next visit. A must-try!

When I first started coming here, they had a terrible system, making you wait at the front counter while they fixed your order. Now they have a much better system where you order and take a number to your table. That way you spend more time with your friends. They've also had some false starts with their cooks. One time I was there and the gravy for the poutine was burnt. The fries were dry and the mussels were overcooked. But in the last 6-8 months it's been good every time. I'm even prepared to say their poutine is the best in the city-if you order it with double cheese. I've had it with salmon as well, which is good. Their salads are gigantic. (I'm going from memory and don't have a picture.)

So the plan to cook Christmas dinner was scuttled. We over stayed the visit to my sister's house and I knew that the duck at my house was still frozen. So when in Rome on Christmas...eat Chinese! Now eating at Cate Zone is not a new experience.  I've been multiple times and never had a bad meal. Sadly, this is my first Yelp review and my apologies to the owners. I've have always had a good meal. This was however, my first take out experience and it wasn't too bad. The main issue was that it was a 90 minute wait. But that was far shorter than 2.5 hours to cook the duck, not to mention the drive time home and prep time. So, as we drove down Olive Bld, drinking our bubble teas and watching the crowds standing in line at the other Chinese restaurants, I felt the decision to substitute Chinese food for the traditional duck dinner was a good choice. I must confess...my drive time was only 4 minutes. So the spicy chicken, the fried Egg Plant and Crisp Pork were still hot and most importantly "crisp" by the time we arrived at my sisters house. The noodles for the braised pork weren't the best but hey all carryout doesn't travel well. I was happy that the other menu items were crisp and hot...so as we reminisce about the past, enjoy the fellowship of family and watch Die Hard, part of the future Christmas "tradition" may include a Chinese carryout potluck at my sister's house...they had brunch earlier but joined us and ordered burgers, cheese fries and chicken from a different restaur

If you want to feel better about what you ate for takeout, this is a great option. I was initially thrown off thinking this was a happy teriyaki alternative, but it's more like a Korean BBQ inspired, protein/veggie on rice joint. 

The meat lives up to the place's name as you can definitely taste the flame broiled flavor. Their magic sauce is good and basically tastes like galbi marinade. I love their double hot sauce... it sort of reminds me of a spicy salsa verde. 

I also appreciate their approach to sauce application. It comes on the side by default so you determine how much sauce you want to put on your food. It's as healthy or semi-healthy as you want it to be. 

If you were initially thrown off like me, I encourage you to give it another take. It can get addicting.
I never ordered from Five Guys before. The two ladies working the register helped me figure out what to order and were so great! Kenya and Jakeira! The food is good too! Thanks
Our family has eaten here many times as it is one of my father's favorite places to eat. The food is excellent. The staff is knowledgeable, prompt, and accommodating.

Decided to try this place because Italian and seafood, why not? Well, after pulling up to the front door, we were slightly wondering about the recommendations. It looked so old but often these places are the best places in my experience. This one did not disappoint! Once inside,  the staff is overwhelmingly kind and courteous. We felt like we were an audience of one! Seating was upstairs and incredibly full of character. The culture oozing from the beautiful paintings, eclectic decor, and the ambiance was welcome. You can peruse Adolfo cooking up your choices. 
We ordered the steak bruschetta as an appetizer. Wow! The steak was cooked to perfection in a happy medium of the tomatoes and garlic sauce. Next, our party ordered pasta with the ocean sauce (a site creation and must not miss!), the steak, grouper, and more pasta! Everything was perfect and exceeded our expectations for sure! The sauces were truly the talk of our table.
 Staff was super attentive and rolled out the Southern charm at every turn. Plus, the bloody Mary's were fantastic. This place is a must visit when you come to New Orleans!

Wow! What a find! We were told about this place by the waitress at Yolk. Amazing, ARTISAN drinks, and situated right by the canal trail. Coffee is the highest quality--- drinks are amazing. It has a really nice vibe. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. Honestly I wish I had seen this earlier in the hour stay! We will be back!

Fantastic food - I should wait to try more off the menu but have to rave about it first. 

Visited on a Friday afternoon, thankfully during their lunch special hours of 11-230 daily. By the time we walked through the door to the time we had our soups there could not have been more than 7 minutes that had passed. 

Started with a Vietnamese-styled coffee which was a nice punch of flavor and energy for the afternoon.

We both had the chicken fried rice, as recommended by our waitress, with soup for $5.50. Egg drop and hot and sour soup were par for the course. The fried rice was quite delicious and very affordable. 

Looking forward to coming back as often as I can.

This time I give it 1. Saturday 18 2018 I visited the restaurant and was seated at 2:30 pm. At the buffet there was no goat (my favorite) and white rice. The owner (woman said they would bring more goat to my table. The goat was delivered to a table in silver boat that looked that it was not washed, tiny pieces of goat which was cold. The white rice was cold as well and had dirty look. The service was very bad and the woman owner was very rude and insulting. Kept saying this man is her father, another man is her husband and father of her son. Apparently. she does not have any social manners. Most importantly, kept calling me mama. I am high degree professional who has been have lunch at the establish frequently since 1916.

Found this place while looking for some key lime pie. I ended up coming here for dinner. We ordered the Calamari appetizer, shrimp & scallop combo w/ rice and waffle fries, and key lime pie for dessert. The Calamari was fresh and had a nice coating to it. But the accompanying marinara sauce was a little too mild for my taste but not bad. Next the main entree was perfect, from the seafood to the sides. The seafood was cooked with lemon pepper on the grill and the taste was spot on. As with all seafood in this area, it's expected to be fresh and this was. As for the sides, I generally don't have much to expect from them, rice is rice and fries are fries. However, the rice was actually cooked pretty well, fluffy, soft, and a soft seasoning.
The fries had a nice crisp and bite to them. Finally, the key lime pie, every bite brings back refreshing memories when I had this as a child. The cream topping was ever so light and soft, nicely pairing with the pie filling which had the perfect lime zest. This combined with the crumbly texture of the pie crust provides the perfect bite. However, the chocolate crust was a little overpowering to the pie taste. All in all a fulfilling meal.

The food is really good but I every time I call in for a carry out order the person who answers the phone sounds like they hate their life. On top of that, when I go to pick up my order they look like they don't want to be there. 5 star food, 3 star customer service.

If I could give Pisces a Negative Star I would. The absolute worst service and management I've ever experienced. I have tried to give this place the benefit of the situation now 7 times. Every single time, I've been disappointed. The host staff is horrible, the wait staff is rude, and the management is the worst I've ever experienced. I lived in Dunedin and I love the area, but please avoid Pisces and do not give them any business.

Love this place. I was so happy to see they have reopened. The tacos were amazing as usual. Great service as always. The new ordering system works well.
See you again soon!

I've had Pi pizza a couple of times now, specifically this location. The folks who work here are very friendly and attentive. I was so excited that they stayed open on Thanksgiving for folks who couldn't necessarily do Thanksgiving dinner. I called like 20 pizza places and Pi was the only local one. Service was fast, too. 

The pizza is very good quality! Thick crust, lots of sauce. A little more saucy than I typically like on pizza but I had goat cheese added and it was delicious. The cornmeal crust is pretty delicious. I'm curious to try to their whole wheat next time.

ion got beef with dairy queen just one person who worked there who was dumb as hell i think his name was pumpkin or sum. ion usually complain about nothin im a simple dude but this foo kinda pissed me off so we ordered something and asked for it without oreo in it and he handed it to us and my cousin says  "oh actually i ordered it without oreo" and this dumbass said "oh you want me to make it all over again?" and i said uhhh duhh mf. but my cousin just said naw it's cool. and then she told him about the dog treat we ordered too and he said oh ok and gave us a lil peanut sized thing in a lil ketchup holder. la neta te pasan de verga pinche pumpkin culero

We have been visiting Veekoo for the last 3 years and have never been disappointed! Pre-COVID we would typically eat in the restaurant, but since then we have done more take out if possible. The orders are always accurate, fresh, visually appealing and delicious!! We have waited at Veekoo for special occasions and we've also been seated immediately numerous times when visiting. We enjoy being able to order online and see pictures of the sushi rolls (we can never remember which ones we like by name, usually by picture). The staff is always friendly and attentive to your needs when dining in, plus it's BYOB! We will always recommend Veekoo to friends and family and will continue to go there for delicious meals!

When we moved to this area we struggled to find a good pizza.  We weren't really thrilled with any of the local options...until we tried Dino's!  Not only is their pizza spot-on in terms of sauce, cheese, and crust ratios (not to mention taste), they have so many other delicious menu items, you really can't go wrong. Dino's has easily become one of our go-to's.  It doesn't hurt that we always feel welcome the second we walk in the door - I love our little community and the businesses that support it! 

Some stand outs?  I've only ever stolen bites of the spaghetti and meatball kids meal, but it's amazing.  It reminds you why cooking Italian at home, while simple, is not the same as good Italian.  I can't wait to try more of their Italian dishes! 

I also had an amazing salad- one of their lunch specials - It was perfectly proportional and there wasn't a lot of junk lettuce (I hate really bad lettuce).  The topping to base ratio was fantastic and the flavor combination was top notch. 

We've also tried a number of other foods and have pretty much liked them all -- the wings are a little more bbq-y then buffalo, but they're still good (although I will say I prefer a crispier wing, but that's just a preference of mine, I wouldn't go out of my way to order theirs, but I wouldn't not order them).  

Oh and the garlic knots...amazing!!  We cut carbs, so a lot of complex carbs got the boot, but I always sneak a little bite when there's a garlic knot from Dino's in the house!

Final
Early dinner was excellent, perfect calamari, oyster sampler, crab cake sandwich and finished with great key lime pie. Friendly attentive service. Very good.

Went to Nashville on vacation and everyone recommended this place! Came with some friends and absolutely loved it. If you enjoy family style eating, this is the place for that! Everything we tried was really good. The feta whip with pita is a must! 

The portions were a little small, but the idea is that you would have multiple dishes and share. Great date night place w/ good vibes.

So good! We got wings, cheesesteak, Stromboli and chicken tenders and fries! Everything was AMAZING! The bread on my cheesesteak was crispy and so were the fries. The buffalo garlic wing sauce is so tasty! 

We ordered online and had 20% off for our first order, there was a mistake and the discount wasn't applied right, so when I went in to pick it up, I asked and they credited me back the money I was supposed to get off. Both cashiers were very friendly about it and helped with no issue.

There is an online tracker which is really nice to see when your order is exactly ready for pick up. 

I highly recommend this place! I wouldn't listen to those other negative reviews.

The best Afghani halal food in town! Reasonable price and delicious food! An amazing afghani Bread (Naan) was so huge and so delicious! Absolutely one of the best in entire USA   
The owner name; which I can never pronounce it right is Shamskamalpry . 
He was very polite And helpful!

I really hate writing reviews and calling businesses out but my experience at Fil a Bagel was terrible this morning.  Not only did I wait for 55 minutes ( bagels were still cooking) but the pork roll and cheese sandwich I ordered was ice cold ... the cheese had never even melted on the sandwich and I asked for the pork roll to be well done and it wasn't .  I probably won't be returning for overpriced bagel sandwiches that look like this.

Also, some of the younger staff are extremely rude.  Thanks but no thanks.

I've ordered take out from here a few times and I have to say it's definitely one of the better Thai/Asian places in the area. All the meat is well cooked, I specifically like the chicken satay appetizer. I did come here once on a Friday with my fiancé and I have to say in my opinion it's not really necessarily the best restaurant to eat in given that it kind of has a "fast food" ambiance to me. I will definitely keep ordering take out though for sure!

This place is super cute, everything is a la carte. So it's $10 for just the burger not including other toppings or fries. There is an entire vegan menu which is real neat (not for me). We had 3 burgers we each created our own. One of them came out wrong but they corrected the best they could. 

I think for 3 people and $60 there are other neat places to try before this one.

Wow, never have I experienced such rude customer service! 

Placed our order online at 6:59pm and when we patiently and politely called to check on it 2.5 HOURS LATER, the first employee that picked up had a terrible attitude. She had no idea what was going on, spending 15 minutes looking up our order on their system and then HUNG UP ON US.. When we called back, another employee picked up and replied with, "uh, yeah, it's out on delivery. I only have one driver tonight" and then hung up! No simple acknowledgement of their lack of competency!

There's no option to even cancel the order so we were trapped with proceeding with it. Pizza got delivered at 10:47pm. INSANE - almost 4 hours later.

The pizza itself was at room temperature of course. Wow do not order from this location. Please save yourself from the unnecessary ill treatment and stress.

I am NEVER disappointed with this place.  As soon as we walked in, we were pleasantly greeted with a beautiful smile. We ordered two platters of the same thing (oxtails, mac & cheese & yams) with cornbread pudding. I normally try the mango salmon which is amazing, but we wanted to try something different.  We waited about 8-10 minutes for our food and this was around 1:30pm on a Saturday (not bad at all).  The portions were just right for two large platters @ $26. Well worth it as the food was properly seasoned, the oxtails had a nice amount of meat on them and the cornbread was yummy.  The place was clean and not too crowded. I will definitely return and I have to try out what appeared to be their Alaskan crab leg platter that was on the electronic menu.

We had the waffle breakfast sandwich and the chicken and waffles. The waffles were soft and fluffy and the chicken was juicy and flavorful! They have the tables spread out for social distancing and they limit the amount of people inside the restaurant. The staff were friendly and helpful and there's plenty of street parking.

Sat outside with the gf and my pup.  Was nice experience.  Service team was pleasant and promptly brought all of us drinks.  

Marinated artichokes were nicely charred with a great vinaigrette.  The pork dumplings were good albeit a tad chewy.  A medium rare burger was perfectly cooked.  Downside was the shoestring fries which were quite greasy.  Decent/better pub.

Boise Fry Company you are absolutely fantastic, I had a lovely experience here yesterday. Boise Fry Company has a great, relaxed, friendly atmosphere. What an excellent dish Sour Thai was. Absolutely heavenly. Incredibly friendly, attentive and experienced. Boise Fry Company - A great spot to stop by when you're in the area.
We were promised 5 minute curbside pickup on a mobile order. After waiting 20 minutes, went inside and were told to reorder in person for carry out. What a mess.

I find it bizarre that Philly doesn't have a Japanese grocery store but I'm happy to make the trip from center city for this awesome store/restaurant. My favorite things to get: takoyaki, milk bread, frozen ramen noodle soup, Japanese skincare items.

Ordered a delivery of three personal pizzas. They only deliver inside the highway lines. Originally wanted it to be delivered to a home just two blocks north of the highway lines but they wouldn't do it. Seems odd since 1. It's covid and people shouldn't be eating out as regularly 2. It's famously known pizza and they should want to the business. Regardless the pizzas were fine. Probably better to buy a large size instead of the personal pies.

Three words: CRUNCHY HOME FRIES. They're salty, oily, herby and plentiful. These alone rank Paladar among my favorite brunch places in the city. And let us not forget their Eggs Benedict. I've never seen so much crab meat in a benedict dish. They never disappoint. Every time I order it I'm swimming in crab meat. It's dream like, really. I've had all the pizzas and would have them all again. I don't even like lamb and I like the housemade lamb sausage pizza. All this goodness under a cool and airy, post-industrial/rustic roof. I'm already plotting my next visit.

Thank you especially to our server Joseph Kris! Such excellent, tentative, and friendly service we received from his and his team lastnight! There were 7 of us out for a Company Dinner and the food was excellent! The atmosphere excellent! And of course service was excellent! This will go down as one of the best dinners by far in Reno. Please visit them... note it is a steakhouse so $$$$ but definitely worth it. Thank u!

Sandwiches are creative and well made but they need to do something about the online order service. On multiple occasions I've ordered online through apps and then received a phone call from them saying that the sandwich I want is only available in California and then having to play the guessing game over the phone as to what they do or don't have. It's a simple issue that causes a problem more often than not.

This place is a textbook definition of 3 stars. For every one thing I really liked, there was something else that was not good. Food wise, tacos are similar to that one would find at other higher end mexican American joints in town, but at 5 bucks a taco, bill can add up quickly. The taste of the tacos overall were standard, not stellar. I ordered habanero salsa, regular salsa, and guacamole which all were below average IMO. The margaritas were largely too sweet other than the spicy margarita which was quite good. Ordered tequila flight which had three 1 oz pours of very smooth tequila, however, to my surprise was 25 dollars and simply nowhere near worth that. The atmosphere was great, nice lighting with wood paneling and live music indoors and great patio seating. Service was wonderful as well. Would like to give this place another try at some point but mixed feelings upon first try.

I went here for after the gym for a quick dinner so my expectations weren't high whatsoever. I ran an extra 15 min on the elliptical because I knew I had a taste for tacos. Honestly I should've saved the calories and just had a margarita. We ordered carnitas tacos, chicken and steak tacos and all of the items fell flat. I am a sucker for a great taco, even the simple ones and honestly between three I can't pick a favorite because in each way they all didn't quite deliver the flavor I was looking for. Thankfully for the restaurant there isn't any other Mexican restaurants with great food on the strip so this one may survive due to the ambience on the second floor and the drinks are pretty good. If you are looking for a nice chill spot to grab a margarita I recommend here over taqueria Felix. However, if your willing to travel an additional 5 minutes for a much better taco, Adobe Cafe will give you what your looking for.
Best calzone ever. Has ricotta in it. Next time I'll ask to skip the moz & ask for extra ricotta. Def will be back. Very homage.

Have eaten here 3 dozen times and it never disappoints and is consistently delicious. The staff is SUPER friendly...I really miss going there during Covid. Had it delivered to office one day and it was pretty good, but not great. Mexican food is best hot and fresh. I recommend picking it up yourself and not using 3rd party delivery.

One of the best taquerias I've been to... and I live in CA! Tortas=amazing! Tacos are great. Salsa selection is superb. The pickled veggies sealed the deal for me though--another level! I will be back next time I'm in town!
This is my to-go to place to get Drunken Noodles and Thai egg rolls in all of Tucson. It's always fresh, made quickly and delicious!

Too long of a wait.  Waited over 35 min for food. Waited over 10 min for water. The music was good but I think it was way to loud and the workers couldn't focus should have stuck with first choice and went to Hattie b but didn't want to walk 35 minutes. I asked about food and said it was coming. Coke was watery it was bad jus bad we walked out

Best Italian food around. Never disappoints. Family owned and  feels authentic.  Love the vibes, and the lighting is perfect for a date or special night out. Good prices for the huge portions they give you. I have never left hungry!

If you like eating as if you were living in communist China as people are standing nearby watching you to make sure your mask is on properly,  not letting you hand your plate back over but having to get a new plate for every food item then this is a " fantastic " choice.  The manager harassed me as I was walking out because my mask fell below my nose and was SO rude! Never again will I go here after 20+ years.

I was worried about this place because it got such a mediocre rating. Most of the reviews had something bad about the customer service and not so much of the food. However it was just one of the few places open on the Hill on Monday. So chanced it and went and it was actually really good! The customer service was decent, given there was only two servers doing their best to keep everyone safe and content. It was non stop with people coming in and the phone ringing so I think they did the best they could. The wait wasn't that long for anything from getting seated to waiting on our food. The atmosphere had a nice touch of elegance to it. Not too bright, not too dark. Everyone spaced out. Order the combo platter for appetizers because could not decide what to get. This was the best toasted raviolis i had here in STL! I've been to Zias, Imo's, Favazzas and this was the best toasted ravioli and calamari in town. It also came with stuffed mushrooms, it was good. The sauce was creamy and tasty. For the main entree, I just got the tortellini. Better than Zias! For one the portion size was bigger, second the pasta was bigger and completely filled with meat too, and they had more bacon topped on it all. My friend had their regular house spaghetti-came with two big meatballs. Nothing to gripe about. Also got a kings meat pizza to go! Just like the description on it, not your average meat pizza. There was a lot of variety of meat on top, thin crust. And it was cheaper than Zias.

Decided to go to my favorite Greek spot in Wesley chapel for some take out. Conveniently Located right across from the hospital on 581. They have a full menu of Greek dishes that are made fresh. They have indoor and outdoor seating as well. 

I got the chicken philly pita with French fries topped with feta cheese. OMG... The tzatziki sauce is to die for. Sorry there is no picture as It was so fresh and yummy I totally forgot!  Definitely check  this place out as they have multiple locations.
Newly renovated to include a deck and ground floor bathrooms. The draught list is greatly expanded. Friendly staff. Good variety of food on the menu. Never had a bad dish here.

My favorite Chinese restaurant in stl! The food is amazing and hot, and the portion sizes are massive. I love this place over other Chinese restaurants because the food is not greasy at all, but rather savory and full of fresh veggies. The service is fast, clean, and friendly. I've never seen a group of employees and owners that work as hard as this crew does every day.
Food was really good and flavorful. Fries are skinny but tasty. Steak wrap was great and the sauce is great. Will be going again.

How can you come to New Orleans and not come to Cafe du Monde? As touristy as it is, I loved it! 

I came with my husband and sister on a Friday night at around 11:00 pm. There was no line whatsoever and plenty of empty tables for us to choose from. We chose a table and waited a bit for a waiter to come take our order. We got 2 orders of beignets, 2 hot chocolates, and one milk. Our order came out super fast afterwards. 

We paid right when they brought out the food and sat back to enjoy it. The beignets were amazing. Soft, fluffy, the perfect sweetness (HUGE pile of powdered sugar just made it perfect in my opinion). It was perfectly fried. The warm beignet with the cold milk was the perfect combination. I highly suggest getting the milk with it. I could not stop eating. I'm actually still dreaming about these beignets with milk. I honestly preferred it to Cafe Beignet. They were just a little bit lighter/airy. 

As everyone else said, they are open 24 hours. They only take cash. You have to scope out your table, and once you find one, a waiter will come to you. This was my first time here, and it could not have been any better. No lines, plenty of tables, no crowds, and the most amazing beignets. I'm sure any other time would be more crowded. But I would def. come back here to get those beignets.
Great place to get good bar food. Their burgers are actually really good here and totally customizable. Now if they can just keep those chicken wings at 85 cents I'm coming back.

I was looking for a Vietnamese place to have for lunch and came across this restaurant. Overall it's alright, pretty decent, we ordered beef brisket pho and grilled pork chop rice. I've got to say that I thought the food would've tasted a better because of the ratings, however I wasn't as impressed. The pork chop portion size was generous but it wasn't as well done and crispy like the way i normally have it. The pho we got in large didn't have that much beef or noodles. Needless to say it was still pretty good overall if you are looking for a viet fix.

This was a delicious restaurant to have our first dinner at NOLA! Our waiter recommended the blackened alligator as an appetizer, and it was AMAZING! The star of the show was definitely the Catfish Napoleon. The crawfish sauce will make you want to eat this fish every single night. We did not have to wait or have a reservation, and the staff was really nice and friendly.

Food and experience are always the best, or at least an interesting dish even if it's not your taste. Staff is friendly and it's a special treat to come here. It does break the wallet so we reserve for very special occasions. Tasting menu consists of 8 small plate courses so you truly get to sample a whole bunch of fine cuisine dishes throughout a 2.5+ hour leisurely meal. In addition, there are biscuits to start the meal and an extra sweet dessert with your check. $9 for a decaf cappuccino is a little ridiculous, but you are paying for the experience and it was delicious. It's clear that the intention is to talk and not feel rushed but truly savor each small bite. Seems like they only host one seating per evening. Meals can take hours but you'll leave feeling like you just experienced something special. 

It can get loud, as it did for us last night, due to rude and obnoxious guests, since the place is small. It's not the restaurant's fault of course, but they could make more of an effort to let people know their voices are traveling and may be disturbing other patrons. It's BYOB which is a plus since you will easily drop $200 for two on their tasting menu.
This restaurant was awesome baby and our waitress Rhaina was all that and more. Traveling all the way from FL we had an awesome experience. Highly recommend

This is a hidden Gem Bbq spot ! I went with their burritos and grab a 1  tri tip and1 brisket burrito  .
I love bbq and got off the norm of it and let me tell you these burritos are packed with meat !! Each one was atleast a pound or better . Loaded with pinto beans pico de gallo Jack cheese and meat !!!
   Trust me check this place out on the real service is a 10 foods a 10 trust !! Need to go back and try a rib plate !!

I came here Sunday for brunch and it was delicious! I ordered a crab Benedict and a strawberry mango mimosa. The service was very good and the server was friendly. I was surprised that there wasn't a lot more people there for Sunday brunch. Definitely coming back and wouldn't mind trying out their dinner!
Great service. Fresh squeezed orange juice. And definitely different things to choose from for breakfast
Three lanes open on Sunday? Will not be going back.literally waited almost 45 minutes in line.

Covididiots.

No one wears a mask here.  This place is a super spreader event.  Just because Ron D Dumbass DeathSantis says we should not wear masks, it does not mean we should listen to him.  Obviously an Ivy League education does not mean shit when the governor has his head so far up Trump's ass that you can see DeDumbass on the back of his throat when Trump opens his mouth.
Greed is running this place, so if you care abt your personal health, you should avoid this place.
Legit. Just like Baja and Southern California. Barbacoa taco supreme and asada quesadilla - fresh and delicious.
Delicious food quickly and at a great price. Make sure to grab a side of guacamole with your order!

Super cool concept, food was yummy and dope drink ideas. the only down fall for it was the fact that it was SUPER loud in there. Everything echoed in the building so when I left my ears were legit ringing. Other than that, service was great. Had plenty of different bartenders touch our table and everyone was nice and personable!

My husband and I ordered a thin crust pizza and it looked good, however it wasn't.  The crust had no flavor and tasted like gas.  It was like it was cooked in a gas oven and lit when the pizza was inside.  We were very disappointed in the pizza because some people had told us how good their pizzas are.  The pizza didn't have much flavor either.  I have never had tasteless pizza before.

This place was bomb dot com. We loved their outdoor patio and it had heaters, too, which was great on this chilly October evening. 

We split the mac and cheese bites and the fry flight which were obviously amazing. The truffle fries are legit to die for. I had the Double Up which rivaled Chicago's famous Small Cheval burger. It was delicious!

Service was great. Everything was awesome. Can't wait to go back and make this my go-to burger spot!

This is my favorite fish market. Always fresh and wonderful choices. And they have the extras to make sashimi or sushi as well. My favorites are the sashimi grades fish and I've found their prepared things are all good, with smoked fish, octopus salad, and seaweed salad. 
Great place also for local catch, so you can get what's in season.

Went last night with a few friends and we really enjoyed our night. Very friendly staff, good pizza and a great vibe to the place. Great addition to the OV !
We met the owners and they really enjoy making guests feel at home.
I ordered online last week for dinner.  The burger was excellent, fries were hot and the food was hot.  I have zero complaints and will visit here again when I'm in Nashville.
World's coolest coffee bar. Seriously delightful atmosphere (and bathroom). The offerings are good - what you would expect. They get all my love because the space is so delightful.

My friend and I passed by here a couple times and kept meaning to go here. When we finally did, we were not disappointed! We came on a Friday night around 10. The hostess who greeted us was super nice and we were seated outside immediately. Our server was also awesome and gave us very helpful suggestions. The cauliflower tacos were impressive, and only around $9 for 3. The Baja fish tacos and rice and beans were also good! Our cocktails were fantastic as well. There were a lot of options that looked really good, and I did not feel they were overpriced at $9. Overall, I was very impressed with the value and with the service. Great affordable taco spot on South Street!

Miss Firebirds happy hour! glad that we've been able to order food for curbside pickup. Staff has been really prompt and friendly. Great deals offered during pandemic.  We've gotten the 7.99 Burger on Thursdays. It's huge and comes with fries and the trimmings. Delish!!
I have had burritos and beer for the past 6 months and it's been so good every time! Outstanding food and service. They've been always been so welcoming every time you walk in. Highly recommend.
Great place to hang out and win prizes. Really enjoyed Bandingo night. We were able to play some of the games and was able to get happy hour specials

I have eaten here so many times I have lost count - dine-in, take out and delivery through UberEats - and I will say that never once have I been disappointed with anything I've ordered. My go-to is the meatball Pho - the broth is flavorful and the portion is a good size. Throw in a little sriracha and it's perfect! I'm also a big fan of the vermicelli bowls - big portions of pork, egg rolls or both if you get a combo. When dining in I have always found the service to be very good - efficient and pleasant- what more can you ask for? On top of that, the prices are very reasonable, especially for the size of the portions. They also have pretty good boba tea. I have tried many pho places and I have my favorite spots to hit up - this is definitely one of them.

We were in St Louis for a game and didn't know where to eat so we decided to stay in and order pizza to be delivered to the hotel. Delfino's didn't answer their phone but Joanie's did and it was delivered within 30 minutes. Delicious pizza and a very courteous delivery man. Will definitely use their delivery service again. Thank you!!

Hidden gem of a sub shop. Reminded me of SUBWAY back in the 1960's on the east coast before they got so commercial. Small place with good ingredients especially the buns they used on the cold sub. Definitely will go back and try other items on the menu.

Wow! Really great pizza at Melo's. I had it for the first time last night and it was the best pizza I've had in a long time. The bake was perfect, as was the cheese and the sauce. Although topping choices are slim, what they have is high quality. I was able to call in my order ahead of their opening time for a later pick up time and my food was brought out right to my car when we pulled up. Service was friendly over the phone and in person. The price was right, especially considering the quality of ingredients. We will be back!
Pho heaven at the 10th power. Thank you Philly for having the greatest pho outside of Vietnam. It's quick, clean flavors, perfect broth, very much worth the trip from NYC.

I placed an order at 7:07pm, and got the notification that my order was being prepared at 7:13.  Estimated ready time was 8:07-8:17.  Arrived at 8:15 to find that they hadn't even started my order.  Waiting an hour only to be told that they could start it now and have it done in 20 minutes?  I understand being busy, but an hour to me seems very extreme.  Never had a place tell me an hour after an order that they didn't even start it.  

And if they set the Tracker to say it was being prepared without actually starting it, thats cruel.
Best bbq in town!!!!!!! Love coming here when in Clearwater. Keep up the great work!!!!

We got dinner tonight from South Philly Italian Kitchen and it was excellent.  Eggplant salad-- basically a caprese salad with slices of crisp fried eggplant-- lobster risotto and chicken Marsala. Everything was delicious, portions are extremely generous and it's very reasonable. I might not have tried the eggplant but they comped us one last time we ate at the restaurant. It's a great combination of flavors and textures. Glad they're in our neighborhood. Check out their weekly specials- the lobster risotto is this week's.

While customers were sitting at the patio, people were not keeping social distancing, especially while placing orders.   

The steak burritos were really good and had good flavor.  I'm disappointed that the burrito came with chips but not salsa.  They charge extra for salsa.  House salsa should come with chips.  To be fair the salsa is like $50 cents each but it is annoying to be told so after the transaction has been completed. 

I do not think it's cool they ask you what percentage tip you would like to give (giving you options of 25%, 30%,. and up..) before the to-go order is given to you.  It's rude since tip is a gratuity based on service and it is determined once the service is completed. 

I think if you are looking for tasty food and you do not mind for the quality of service or that they are not intentionally asking customers to keep social distancing then it's a place you should consider.

Was here for lunch with my daughter.  I had toasted ravioli, it was cooked too long and the crust was kinda tough and chewy.  I also had a cup of their soup of the day, clam chowder, and it was really good.  Daughter had the salad with house dressing, said it was good.  Will be back.
Wow. Just ordered the jalapeño aioli sandwich from here and it was amazing. I like spicy, but it was really spicy - in a good way. Can't wait to try some of their other sandwiches

Food was fine. Service was good. Honestly I was initially concerned about all the negative reviews about service but we had nothing but a good experience. Oh and the pretzel with cheese dip tasted fresh and soft. Will probably stop here again just for that.

Delicious! Just visited here for the first time! The food is good. I'm not a big fan of hot dogs so I had a delicious beef sandwich with hot peppers was perfect.  My wife had a chili cheese dog which she found to be good as well. We don't have many restaurants like this in town. Definitely check them out

The classic eggs benedict was delicious. Awesome service like always. The owner is super friendly and always comes out from kitchen and ask how everything is. This establishment is a little hidden gem in Safety Harbor. Bonus is several outdoor seating options.

After grabbing ramen around the corner we stopped in for a drink. The black sugar tea was excellent, perfectly creamy & sweet with a strong tea flavor as well. The guy working today was super friendly and helpful & helped us navigate their extensive menu. If you're looking for quick delicious tea, definitely check this place out.
The food was amazing. Great atmosphere and very friendly staff. My waitress Bre took great care of me during my visit.

This McDonald's is the worst ever I moved here one year ago and it's very close to my house but I have never since such poor customer service in my life very rude managers the crew members have always been great but do something with the managers customer service and when you complain no one calls you back so it's like the owners don't even care.
We had a great first experience at Butcheryown Hall! Great vibe, friendly service, fantastic craft beer list and yummy food. They also have a great patio. We will definitive back!

This place was recommended to me as a cool bar/ Restraunt for having a cigar on the patio. They do let you do that but they ask you to sit in the back by the spare stacked chairs and such. The food is above average for a bar with menu offerings that you would more commonly see at higher end eateries. The rotating tap bar keeps things fresh. This is a good addition to the NW side of town.

This pizza and environment is perfect! The only reason I am giving this 3 stars is because I am so turned off by the fact they are using paper plates and plastic silverware. In today's world, we all need to make a conscious effort to move toward renewable materials. It infuriated myself and my entire family enough to not want to come back. Please, please make a change! Even if these plates and plastic wear are biodegradable, they are extremely wasteful. I'd love to come back to Vince's if they make this change.

This place is delicious & the serves is fast. We got seated right away & within less than 2 mins they came to take our order. Everyone was friendly but overall it's a great place for brunch. I truly enjoyed the food :)

Food was great, tacos were delicious. The beet salad was beyond what I expected, and the por boy sandwich was worth breaking keto. HELLA GOOD. Definitely coming back next time I am in Reno. The donut holes and the ameretto gelato outstanding. I'm sorry we didn't take pictures....

I noticed that in NOLA all places that serve oysters are term "the best oysters" but OMG.... This place serve the best oysters I've ever had! I'm a big oyster eater and by far the best! Must check out.

We had a great dinner here last night! I had the grilled salmon special and it was the best salmon that I've ever had. It was nicely seasoned, perfectly grilled, served with a grilled lemon and a mild horseradish sauce. My wife had the scallops from the menu and they were delicious, served with a citrus couscous. Yum!! Our service was great! We always have a nice time when we eat here.
This place is great but doesn't hold a candle to the Lexington Market in Baltimore, Maryland. That is the only reason it's getting 4 stars.

My husband decided to go on an elimination diet to identify any food intolerances he might have and it was limiting what I could cook for dinner. Between making special meals for my husband and our toddler I was starting to feel like a short order cook. My husband decided to have meals delivered to our home from Eat Right. Since I wanted to lose some weight too I selected the conventional meal plan for myself and my husband selected the keto meals.

Every week we receive meals delivered to our front door step. Meals for Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday are delivered Monday morning and Thursday and Friday's meals are delivered Thursday morning to ensure the freshest meals. We could have meals delivered for the weekend on Thursday, but we enjoy cooking and occasionally dining out so we opted to not do meals during the weekend.

I was a little skeptical how the meals would taste since I have tried other prepared meals in the past, but the meals at Eat Right have been pretty good if not sometimes excellent! The chimichurri steak, steak hibachi, chicken sandwich, beef enchiladas and Asian meatballs have been some of my favorite dishes. The most surprising thing about the meals have been the high quality cuts of meat. The steaks are usually very tender and contain little to no gristle. 

There have been a few misses. I haven't been a fan of most of the ground turkey meals and now avoid them when selecting my weekly menu. A few of the vegetables have been underwhelming such as plain gr

I had higher hopes for The Boathouse, but still had an overall enjoyable experience. I went for lunch and ate outside - the view of the water was lovely. The menu seemed a little limited, even for a lunch, just a one-sided page. The menu consists of appetizers, salad/soup, sandwiches, and flatbreads, with a few options in each category. I had the pepperoni and bacon flatbread, which was good, but seemed small for the $13 price tag. As other reviewers have mentioned, the cost to product ratio seems off. Another person in my group just ordered an appetizer and still paid about the same amount as those of us who ordered a sandwich or flatbread. Overall, the ambiance and view were beautiful, but the food seemed overpriced.

Just went with my partner, we ordered at the front and the service was quick and pleasant. The burrito we got was very tasty (albeit overpriced for sure). I ordered a lavender LATTE, and one would assume a latte has espresso in it... considering it's a latte.... however, when I got outside and took a sip I thought it just tasted like oat milk in ice. I opened my cup up to see, that was pretty much exactly what it was, no espresso or coffee in site. My partner went back inside to see if it was a mistake and the espresso had been left out, and he was told at the front that the LATTES don't come with espresso???? What. A latte is literally a form of milk and espresso. While they may change in flavors and milk types sure, they all have one thing in common.... espresso.

We came to Indian Shores for vacation and we tried this place after seeing it on yelp. There is only one word for this restaurant- disappointing. The first couple times we came the food was okay, but the drinks were great. I think Caddy's is good for a casual, laidback snack and drinks, but not something die for. We went there for breakfast and it was just bland. We sat at the waterfront and the view was great and the shade was nice, but don't waste your time or money on breakfast. The service was not great either, the waitress was kind of checked out and forget to get us salt to help with the bland food. In conclusion, the food-not great, but the drinks were the best part. Don't waste your time with this bland, soggy, disappointing food.

My wife and I moved to Boise about 6 months and have been looking for a good Chinese food restaurant as we are food enthusiasts. Finally we have found our go to Chinese food spot. Yen Ching is extremely clean, which is a must for us, and the food and the service is exceptional.
Best Thai food in franklin!! They also have Japanese food including Ramen and tonkutsu.  Great service and friendly staff. Small family style restaurant.  Must try!!

The food wasn't the same as I remember it before which is a good thing because last time I was less than impressed.  This food today was exquisite!  The flash fried Brussels sprouts were the perfect appetizer dish.  Delicious, lightly spiced, savory, and a dash of salt for flavor.  Then we followed with a pizza.  Alfredo with smoked gouda, TO DIE FOR.  I'm adding that one to my cravings list.  I'm a woman who indulges on complex flavors often and this meal did not disappoint...until the dessert.  

I encouraged the waitress to give me their best dessert dish between the cheese cake and the beignets.  She recommended the beignets.  "What topping?!"  "You pick your favorite".  Either this waitress isn't considering her favorite or she is just picking a random dessert.  They were mildly flavorful, just basic strawberry syrup on top with a light powder of powdered sugar.  Girl, people in the south coat these things...why am I just getting a sprinkle of powdered sugar.  To follow that up, they were over cooked.  Brown, bordering crispy, with an over cooked burnt taste.  I did tell the waitress they they were over cooked she said, "that is because they fry them".  I received no replacement, just received an explanation that these are always made this poor.  

I will be back because the rest of the menu screams "explore me!" So I will do just that.  I will do so in hopes the rest of the menu holds true with those Brussels and not with the beignets.
Don't go here unless you want to get sick..No masks and girl behind the cash register kept touching her hair. Awful!

Such a cute little cafe. Perfect for a quick breakfast or lunch. The staff is friendly, good service, the food is very good, and the place has lots of personality. Wasn't too fond of the smoothies as they didn't taste natural, but everything else was very good!
Unfortunate visit. Dirty restaurant. Overcooked burger. Unresponsive staff. Save $ and do fast food next door.

I would suggest you reconsider trying another Argentinian/ Peruvian restaurant in Tampa. The food may be appetizing yet the service that comes with it will take away that satisfaction immediately. You may have to wait anywhere from 10-15 mins before anyone comes to your table to take a drink order. That's solely just drinks. The servers will say that they are busy yet are only walking around asking other guests how there meal is just a table away from yours and presume to walk away explicitly acknowledging that you are already seated with no attention to. Also they will say they are slammed busy yet are putting a tables dinner in a Togo container. There really weren't that many tables compared to the number to servers. The ratio didn't add up. Hopefully they restaurant management realizes that service is key to keep customers in your doors.

I love giving my black ppl business but I'm even more livid when I don't get what is ordered. How dare you send my UberEats order out with half the order and made no attempt to contact me about there being a change to the order... I can compromise! But thank you! Uber eats gave me my money back and I won't patronize again. I can respect business when business is respectful and  why if it's take out and delivery only wouldn't you answer your phone?! #ItsBeenReal #NoThankYou

One of my go-to places for comfort food. They have made precautions in their dining area due to COVID so diners can feel better. But their fried chicken and their fish are amazing, The rolls are sweet and buttery, and the sides make it easy to down multiple plates. Tampa, is pretty scarce on southern comfort food, but Fred's definitely hits the spot.
Excellent service, delicious food and drinks. The Hurricane was yummy and the roast beef po' boy was so good. Off the main drag so less crowded. Highly recommend.

I've been here 4 times and every time has been great!  I've had something different each time and enjoyed everyone one of them.  The first time I went service was a little slow but that was right after they opened.  No complaints any other time!  I've had the barramundi, the lettuce wraps, the nachos, the bruschetta and the quest.  All were delicious!  The place was pretty empty on a Saturday night which doesn't bode well so go out and support this local restaurant!

Ok seriously...this is one of my FAVORITE bakeries. EVER. Holy COW. I heard good things about this place but I was truly BLOWN away. My all time favorite was the Pistachio sticky bun. It is truly a fluffy chewy heavenly pillow that you want to eat over and over again.The second best was the chocolate rugelach, hands down best i've ever had. I also ordered the bulgarian feta boreka and it was delicious but my least fav out of the three. This place gets packed, especially on the weekends. I would definitely come back here again!!!

BOMB! The food, as pictured, was delicious and I paid $21 so not bad considering the portion size & I got sushi. Excellent customer service. There is a window where you pick the food up from. I called ahead and the food was ready when they said it would be, about 15 min. I just moved here and have gone to a couple places & the food does not compare. This is going to be my Chinese food place! 

Also, you can actually save it for leftovers & it will taste just as good - not like other places!

I have been a long time customer of Angelo's in Larchmont with numerous great meals and experiences and various service staff who were attentive, observant, and clean.  In the last year or so, I have been disappointed in the direction this once a gem of a restaurant is headed. 

In years past you came into Angelo's and were greeted, tables were wiped and set and the dining room was neat as a pin.  My family and I have not seen this in visits as of late.  In our latest dining experience, the dining room was moderately busy but not bustling like on a Friday night.  Our table wasn't set and we weren't greeted for a few minutes.  Our waitress wasn't personable and was not trained very well in being efficient.  She gave us menus.  When we ordered our drink and they arrived, they weren't filled to the top and were plopped onto the table.  We ordered our food and waited.  The food came out without any eating utensils, (my wife had to get up and ask someone in the kitchen area). The salad looked unappetizing and was not filled.  I also pulled a hair out of my mouth as I ate my sandwich but didn't want to make a fuss. There is no comparison to years past and the amount of emotion, taste, and great service that every staff member used to display.  I also would see Pino, the owner all the time preparing pizza after pizza guiding his staff on a busy night.  However, while the cat's away, the mice will play.  I was wondering what is going on there as the passion has gone. I do hope this r
The best cheesesteak in the city.  The service was excellent.  I can't wait to go back and have another cheese steak.

Extremely Rude Business Owner/Manager! I decided to give this business a try on Sunday since I was in Santa Barbara. After 15 minutes of waiting, one of the employees came up to me and stated that she didn't see my ticket in the kitchen and wanted to know what I ordered. I restated my order and she then mentioned that they weren't getting people's orders because the system was malfunctioning for some reason. I said that it wasn't a problem and continued to wait. After about 5 more minutes (and noticing that people who ordered after me were getting their drinks) I approached the pick-up window and asked if I could get my drink order. They were a bit confused and extremely flustered, which is understandable considering that they were backed up. However, one of the gentlemen came through. After 45 minutes of waiting for my food and (again) noticing that people who ordered 10 minutes after me received their food, I asked one of the employees if I could please get a refund. She immediately went to the kitchen and came out with my plate. I stated that I didn't want my food and if I could just get my refund (primarily because I had a 60 minute drive home). She looked upset and went into the kitchen to call the manager. I walked to the pick-up window next to the kitchen entrance and waited. The owner/manager then asked me, "What's wrong with the food?" I said nothing and mentioned that I had been waiting for a long time and just wanted a refund so that I could leave. He gave me the s

Very upset with this store!  Picked up chicken fried chicken dinner with mashed potatoes w/ sawmill gravy.  The potatoes were dried out & i could see gravy was slopped on over those disgusting potatoes.  When I spoke to manager, he said he had seen they were dried out & told the kitchen to throw them out.  I guess we were the unlucky ones that got that disgusting batch!  
Ugh!  The manager said we could pick up mash potatoes the next day, but don't think I want to eat their food anymore.  Yuk!!!

This spot was so great for bunch along mass ave. The service was very nice, and the food was amazing. It was a very picturesque spot, perfect for getting that perfect Instagram brunch picture. Great location and good options for food.
The coffee was great and the guava n cheese pastry was delicious. I am from out of state and was told I should make a effort to stop in, I'm glad i did it was well worth it.
I love love love BMB!! It's a favorite for decadent banh mis and loaded fries. I recommend their special banh mis, 100%! #thankyouthursday #yelplove

The food and our server were great, but they need to work on their hospitality with other 'ethnic' groups. Found this restaurant through yelp since we weren't from around here. We were a group of 7 and were glad the restaurant wasn't too busy when we first walked in. There were tables that were empty outside and noticed that there were several tables open inside as well, where one of the big tables by the entrance were open. We didn't question the 30 minute wait because we just assumed that the these tables were open because of social distancing. Gave the hostess my name and phone number and she said she would text when our table was ready. So we decided to walk around to burn time. We had hungry kids in our group and I constantly checked for the text. I noticed we still haven't received a text as it has been close to 45 minutes already. We decided to walk back to the restaurant to find out how much longer the wait would be. We noticed that the tables outside had people occupying them and noticed there were more empty tables inside. I gave the lady my name to check on the status of our table and unsurprisingly, she seated us right away. When she was getting the table ready, I noticed on the tablet that we had waited 52 minutes of the 30 minutes we were told. It's unfortunate that she sat us down at the table that was free when I first put my name in. When I told her that the table she was seating us was free when first we came in, she reassured us it wasn't free as the 'clean

Normally I give places the benefit of the doubt and understand that they are teenagers working so I disregard a lot when it comes to professionalism. However this location is not following proper safety guidelines during Covid. I witnessed employees talking without masks and without gloves assembling the boxes that's customers food was being put into. This type of negligence when it comes to safety especially during a pandemic is just unacceptable and management needs to take responsibility.
Love the food and the cute little patio. Went for happy hour with friends for their BoGo Tacos. Did not disappoint!!

Great location and vibes. We ordered wedge salad crabcakes and shrimp cocktail as apps. All very good although cocktail sauce needed more zing. Entrees ordered: filet, fish tacos, blackened shrimp and sirloin, and braised short ribs (my fav) All were good but the quality and taste is almost reminiscent of a chain restaurant. Our server Matilda was attentive and pleasant. I would come back.
Service was good and the clam chower. The fish and chips were horrible. The restaurant understood and took care of it for me.

Stopped for lunch at Bossie's Kitchen. Probably the best quiche I've ever had. The citrus salad was fresh and light. The salmon tender and balanced with the tabbouleh and fresh peas. If you're looking for a tasty meal stop here.

Incredibly bland. Figured a barbecue spot wouldn't have meat reminiscent of Applebees frozen meat. Tasted almost unseasoned. Only leaving this review because I was suckered into eating here by the surprisingly high reviews.
Got baked salmon roll and Phoenix roll and threw them both away because they tasted extremely fishy and gross

I've been meaning to write a review about this place for a long time now. We always get it catered for our work events and have been totally satisfied every single time. We always get a variety of all of their bread options: sourdough, marble rye, whole wheat, multi grain, and my favorite...croissant. They also have a good selection of cheeses: smoked gouda, havarti, pepperjack, provolone, swiss, cheddar, blue. My favorite sandwich is the triple club, which has ham, turkey, bacon, cheddar, and swiss cheese. I love to slather the bread with their oh so tasty pesto mayo. It's seriously all I need to get by. The salads are also fantastic. We always get a big order of the club salad, which has turkey, ham, bacon, egg, tomato, cucumber, croutons, cheddar, and swiss cheese. Their balsamic vinaigrette is pretty good but I like their ranch with the club salad. The food is always fresh and they deliver it right to us.

I used to come here multiple times per week with the previous owners.  I'm a genuine lover of all things breakfast and loved that there was a local spot to enjoy my mornings.  Unfortunately, the past few times I've been back under new ownership have been less than thrilling each time.  I've only returned multiple times to give this restaurant that used to be one of my favorites another shot.  Below is what I've recently noticed each time I've been here (same occurrences each visit)

1. Forgotten about it's regulars and the favorites on the menu that allow us to come in multiple times per week. While the new menu is attractive and tastes good, it is far more expensive and lacks the homestyle feel this spot used to have. 

2.  Food quality/atmosphere has declined. Their bacon seems to be the precooked thin slice bacon. They have run out of items each time I have been in (even during non busy weekends). Dishwashers are wandering around the front area grabbing items in their dishwashing gloves.  Happy to see they kept the cook. Sad to see some of the employees that made this spot feel like home are gone, but I can't blame them for leaving.

So I really wanted to like this place. The location and name itself is super cute however I was not sold on the food. I got a cinnamon roll, rose pistachio bar and sundried tomato tart. The Rose bar was the best of the three, Was not a fan of the tomato tart at all; and the cinnamon roll I feel like you can't screw up but I could have made better at home. Generally very instagram-worthy food and location but wish the taste matched. Caveat: I am not a vegan only eater though. Maybe that matters.

They have A good menu. I think that if you would go here regularly you should probably join the frequent diners club here. The thing to order on the menu is wings trashed and then you have them trashed again and deep-fried and that is the veteran move and it is amazingly delicious. Daily specials are generally good.

Overall a great experience! We came in during a rush, waited around 20 min or so for a table. When seated it took a min to get service but it was busy so we understood. Stumbled across the restaurant while running errands in the area. Great food and excellent service! Would definitely go back next time in the area.
